profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Warner Bros. Discovery
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer at Warner Bros. Discovery
profile.summary:
I earn a living as a software engineer based in Los Angeles, CA. I take pride in creating top-notch applications that always exceed my clients' highest expectations. My professional career started over two decades ago and I've been crafting cutting-edge mobile, set-top, desktop and web applications ever since. I'm a strong believer in empowering people to reach their full potential and to be creative. Staying at the top means being up-to-date in current trends and industry best practices as well as researching emerging technologies. New technologies bring new horizons to what's possible in application development and there is nothing like beating the competition to it.
I believe that by providing truly engaging experiences, I can make somebody's life a little better, and in my opinion, I couldn't ask for anything more rewarding than that.

Specialties: Swift, TypeScript, React, React Native, JavaScript, BrightScript, HTML5, CSS, PHP, Python, MySQL, etc

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer at Warner Bros. Discovery
positions.description:
I started working at Discovery, Inc. in March 2012. I was part of a Los Angeles based team. I contributed in the development of a web-based project called Collagio.

In 2013, Discovery acquired a new media company based in San Francisco, Revision3. I joined the Revision3 team as a Video Player engineer and my main role was to continue development on their existing web Video Player platform, based on the MediaElement.js JavaScript framework. Eventually, Discovery put together a team (that included myself) to start working towards the integration of a new secret project from Google called "Eureka". This project became what everybody knows now as Chromecast, when it released.

Towards the end of 2014, I started working on the Roku apps for Discovery. I created several apps for some of our most popular properties, some of these Roku apps included, Revision3, DNews, TestTube and Seeker. These were some of the most successful apps for the company and drove much of the traffic and profits for the company's online portfolio.

In 2015, I joined the Discovery New York team to start working on the Discovery GO suite of apps. Here, I created a Roku platform that would be the foundation for creating 16 different Roku apps for most of the Discovery networks, including, Discovery GO, TLC GO, Investigation Discovery GO, Animal Planet GO, HGTV GO, etc. At the same time I was creating these Roku apps, I was also contributing in the development of the Apple TV apps, this platform also supported the 16 Discovery networks and was developed using TVML and TVJS technologies.

At the beginning of 2018, Discovery decided to prototype the existing suite of Discovery GO apps with React Native. We targeted iOS, tvOS and Android apps with React Native and used TypeScript as the programming language of choice.

Since late 2019, I've been working with the Ad Technology team for the Apple platform (iOS and tvOS) on the Discovery+ platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop ad templates to make it easier for Flash designers and developers to create Flash rich media ad units that include audio, video and engaging interactivity. Some of these templates include push-down units, page-take-over ads, etc. I'm also responsible for creating any other type of component requested by our team. I also created a suite of video (and video controls) components that make it possible to add video to Flash creatives effortlessly. The video components support http progressive playback, rtmp streaming and dynamic bitrate streaming

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Created and maintained features for the Flash-based karaoke player. Some of these features included video integration, lyrics rendering engine, and components that interacted with an ActiveX recorder. Also in charge of creating any type of Flash components required by our group, video, audio, and pretty much any type of Flash based widgets and applications.

positions.title: Flash Developer
positions.description:
Developed interactive Flash training modules to be used by Honda/Acura technicians across the United States. These modules were developed using Flash, XML, HTML, and JavaScript.
Created top-notch animations describing the subject matter being discussed in the training modules. These animations had to be synchronized to a voice-over track describing in detail the core subject of the module. Some of these animations explained how some of these systems work: Automatic Transmission, Engines, Electrical Systems, TPMS Systems, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: XML · CSS · Agile Methodologies · ActionScript · User Interface Design · PHP · Scrum · HTML · Flash · Linux · DHTML · Flex · User Experience · User Interface · Web Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed cutting-edge Flash Communication Server application where thousands of people exchanged real-time information on a daily basis using video, chat, VOIP (Voice-Over Internet Protocol), PowerPoint slides, file exchange, polling, video recording, whiteboarding, etc. This application competed directly with top leading web conferencing solutions (WebEx, Microsoft’s Live Meeting, Macromedia’s Breeze Live, etc).
